capabilities: Detect publication citations in Reading View and Live Preview
Turn each citation into a clickable wol.jw.org search link
Accept varied citation forms such as glued years, page ranges and paragraph markers
Open links in a chosen output language
Set citation link color from presets or a custom hex value
disambiguation: Not a general Bible or scripture reference linker; it only links Jehovah's Witnesses publication citations to wol.jw.org.
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js, styles.css, manifest.json into .obsidian/plugins/inrefens). Changing the link color requires restarting Obsidian; changing the language reloads the parsing engine. README warns that unofficial forks exist and are not endorsed.
problem: Publication citations written in notes are plain text, so they cannot be opened or checked against the online research edition without manually copying the reference into a search.

relations.evidence: it lets in(REF)ens coexist with tra.VER:ture without ambiguity

summary: Citation parser that detects references to Jehovah's Witnesses publications in notes and links them to wol.jw.org searches.
